features_built: Site-wide Bungu.store style redesign (minimalist, photo-first, monochrome palette)
Modularized layout with js/layout.js injecting the header, footer, and cart drawer dynamically across pages
Dynamic Homepage with Hero Section, auto-generated Category Tiles, and Featured Products populated from data/products.json
Product Quick-View Dialog with color variant swatches and quantity selection
Advanced Shopping Cart with localStorage persistence and a WhatsApp Checkout Flow
Dynamic Delivery Charges (Free delivery over Rs. 7,000) and JazzCash Safety Notes integrated in WhatsApp order messages
Contact Page that builds and redirects to a pre-filled WhatsApp message
Python tools for dummy data generation (tools/make_dummy_products.py) and bulk image WebP optimization (tools/resize.py)
Responsive mobile-first navigation and dark mode support

html_files.index.html: The homepage. Dynamically loads category tiles and featured products using JavaScript, and relies on layout.js to inject global components.
html_files.products.html: The full product catalog page. Contains a search/filter toolbar and a grid to display all products with 'Show More' pagination.
html_files.contact.html: The contact page. Displays business details and a contact form that formats user inputs into a WhatsApp message.

css_files.style.css: The main stylesheet. Built using a minimal, monochrome, photo-first design system inspired by Bungu.store. Uses CSS variables for theming and fully supports a muted dark mode.

javascript_files.js/config.js: The single source of truth for the shop's configuration. Holds the shop name, WhatsApp number, delivery fees, and payment safety notes.
javascript_files.js/layout.js: A global layout injector. Defines the HTML strings for the header, footer, and cart drawer, and dynamically inserts them into all pages to completely eliminate code duplication.
javascript_files.js/products.js: The catalog engine. Fetches products.json, handles searching, sorting, category filtering, pagination, and rendering the quick-view modal with color swatches.
javascript_files.js/cart.js: The shopping cart engine. Manages cart state using localStorage, updates the slide-out cart UI, calculates totals and dynamic delivery fees, and builds the final WhatsApp order message.
javascript_files.js/contact.js: Handles contact form submission by capturing user input, performing basic validation, and opening a pre-filled WhatsApp chat instead of requiring a backend service.

data_and_tools.data/products.json: The flat-file database. A JSON array containing all products, their color variants, prices, and stock statuses.
data_and_tools.tools/make_dummy_products.py: A testing utility that generates a massive catalog (1,500+ items) of realistic dummy products, variants, and out-of-stock states, and saves them to products.json.
data_and_tools.tools/resize.py: A bulk image optimization script using the Python Pillow library. Resizes images to a maximum of 1200px, handles alpha transparency, corrects EXIF rotation, and converts them to highly compressed WebP format.

error_report.issue_description: The homepage was completely blank ('nothing pops up in the website') after running the make_dummy_products.py script.
error_report.root_cause: During the redesign of index.html, the template literal backticks (`) and string interpolations (${...}) were accidentally escaped with backslashes (\) in the JavaScript code. This caused a critical 'Uncaught SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token' which prevented the script from fetching and rendering the products.
error_report.code_with_error:
a.innerHTML = \`

\${cat}

View collection → \`;
error_report.how_it_was_fixed: The stray backslashes were removed from the template literals across all dynamic rendering blocks (both the category tiles and the featured products) inside index.html. This allowed the browser to properly parse the JavaScript and render the dummy products.
